_comment: Band-fusion coefficients (scripts/band_fusion_refit.py): GT acceleration regressed on Gaussian-difference bands of the refined (VPQ3-base) and raw human, per band and axis group, on 59 FORM-HOI sequences (nvidia/form-hoi, CC BY-4.0; two disjoint sets of 30, fits averaged). Order: k_B0..k_B4 (ours), m_B0..m_B4 (raw); B4 forced to 1/0 by the script.
